description: Fetch one Google Maps listing in full: name, categories, formatted_address, location, rating, user_ratings_total, rating_distribution, price_level, phone numbers, website, opening_hours, the About tab and business_status. popular_times is in the object, and null where the source does not give it. Accepts a Google place_id — from a search, the Places API or anywhere else — or a Google Maps URL. Give exactly one of `place_id` or `url`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

language.description: Two-letter language code for localised text, e.g. `en`, `de`.

place_id.description: Google's place ID, e.g. from a search result or the Places API.

url.description: The full URL of the place on Google Maps, which carries its id. A short maps.app.goo.gl link does not, so open it and copy the address it leads to.

name: get_place
title: Get one Google Maps place in full
